description: Every E590 existence test the M3 step bundles deleted (b8f3fd0..e087deb), recorded for the M4 resolver: each case becomes a resolver fixture. old_test is the deleted test, old_input what it fed the removed check, new_link_field the 1.2.0 field that now carries the link, expected what the resolver reports for it.

cases.old_input: 06 rule inv-auth-required with trace [fr fr-login, api api-auth]; 04 lists fr-login, 05 lists api-auth
cases.expected: no finding

cases.old_input: 06 rule with trace [fr fr-login, api api-auth]; no 04 and no 05 file in the spec folder
cases.expected: warning that each absent upstream file is missing (was W590)

cases.old_input: 06 rule with trace [fr fr-unknown, api api-missing]; 04 lists fr-login only, 05 lists api-auth only
cases.expected: one dangling-link finding per id: fr-unknown, api-missing (was E590)

cases.old_input: 06 rule inv-session-valid with trace [inv inv-auth-required]; the target is a rule of the same file
cases.new_link_field: none: constrains takes fr, api, component and connection, so a rule-to-rule link has no field in 06; M4 decides
cases.expected: no finding
